_comment: Shipped to the CLUSTER. `launch.py` copies this into a run root and points a remote
agent at it with --mcp-config --strict-mcp-config, so an agent reaches these servers
and nothing else. Which of them a given agent gets is its `mcp:` list.
The LAPTOP manager uses `.mcp.json` at the repo root instead — Claude Code reads that
one by itself, which is what makes a bare `claude` here the manager.
